# Catalogue

Public reference data: supported countries, carriers and routes. No authentication. For developers who want to show coverage or validate destinations.

Back to the [API reference index](README.md). Shared shapes are in [Schemas](schemas.md); conventions (auth headers, errors, pagination, idempotency) are in the [index](README.md#conventions).

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | [`/v1/countries`](#get-v1countries) | List active destination countries with workspace pricing |
| GET | [`/v1/countries/{iso2}/carriers`](#get-v1countriesiso2carriers) | List carriers for a country |
| GET | [`/v1/countries/{iso2}/routes`](#get-v1countriesiso2routes) | List public routable providers for a country |

## GET /v1/countries

**List active destination countries with workspace pricing**

Operation ID: `listCountries`. Tag: `Catalogue`.

Public. price_per_message is the caller's effective base-tier sell price (workspace override when a workspace credential is presented, otherwise the platform default); null when no usable price book, cost or FX rate exists. sender_kinds and providers_available reflect currently routable providers only.

**Auth:** None. Public endpoint.

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Active countries. | `application/json`: array of object |
| `503` | A required dependency is unavailable. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields (per array item):

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `iso2` | string | yes |  |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `dial_code` | string | yes |  |  |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |  |
| `status` | string | yes |  |  |
| `price_per_message` | object \| null | yes |  |  |
| `price_per_message.amount` | string | yes |  |  |
| `price_per_message.currency` | string | yes |  |  |
| `sender_kinds` | array of string | yes |  | One of: `alphanumeric`, `numeric`. |
| `providers_available` | integer | yes |  | Constraints: minimum `0`. |

**Example**

<!-- tabs label="Request example" -->
```bash tab="cURL"
curl -s -X GET "$OPENSMS_API/v1/countries"
```

```ts tab="TypeScript"
const opensms = new Opensms({ apiKey: process.env.OPENSMS_API_KEY! });

const countries = await opensms.countries.list();

for (const item of countries) {
  console.log(item.iso2, item.name);
}
```

```python tab="Python"
client = Opensms(api_key=os.environ["OPENSMS_API_KEY"])

countries = client.countries.list()

for item in countries:
    print(item["iso2"], item["name"])
```

```go tab="Go"
client, err := opensms.NewClient(os.Getenv("OPENSMS_API_KEY"))
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
ctx := context.Background()

countries, err := client.Countries.List(ctx)
if err != nil {
	log.Fatal(err)
}
for _, item := range countries {
	fmt.Println(item.ISO2, item.Name)
}
```

```php tab="PHP"
$opensms = new Client(getenv('OPENSMS_API_KEY'));

$countries = $opensms->countries->list();

foreach ($countries as $item) {
    echo $item['iso2'], ' ', $item['name'], PHP_EOL;
}
```

```java tab="Java"
OpensmsClient opensms = new OpensmsClient(System.getenv("OPENSMS_API_KEY"));

var countries = opensms.countries().list();

for (var item : countries) {
    System.out.println(item.iso2 + " " + item.name);
}
```

```csharp tab="C#"
using var client = new OpensmsClient(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("OPENSMS_API_KEY")!);

var countries = await client.Countries.ListAsync();

foreach (var item in countries)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{item.Iso2} {item.Name}");
}
```

```ruby tab="Ruby"
client = Opensms::Client.new(api_key: ENV.fetch("OPENSMS_API_KEY"))

countries = client.countries.list()

countries.each do |item|
  puts "#{item[:iso2]} #{item[:name]}"
end
```

```rust tab="Rust"
let client = Client::new(std::env::var("OPENSMS_API_KEY").unwrap())?;

let countries = client.countries().list().await?;

for item in &countries {
    println!("{} {}", item.iso2.as_deref().unwrap_or_default(), item.name.as_deref().unwrap_or_default());
}
```

```swift tab="Swift"
let apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["OPENSMS_API_KEY"] ?? ""
let opensms = try OpensmsClient(apiKey: apiKey)

let countries = try await opensms.countries.list()

for item in countries {
    print(item.iso2 ?? "", item.name ?? "")
}
```

## GET /v1/countries/{iso2}/carriers

**List carriers for a country**

Operation ID: `listCountryCarriers`. Tag: `Catalogue`.

**Auth:** None. Public endpoint.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `iso2` | path | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `2`, maxLength `2`. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Carriers in the country. | `application/json`: array of object |
| `503` | A required dependency is unavailable. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields (per array item):

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `name` | string | yes |  |  |
| `mcc_mnc` | array of string | yes |  |  |

## GET /v1/countries/{iso2}/routes

**List public routable providers for a country**

Operation ID: `listCountryRoutes`. Tag: `Catalogue`.

Public view of currently routable routes. sell_price is the caller's effective per-message sell price for the route (carrier book, then country book) using live billing markup math; null when not determinable. p50_ms is the latest daily-rollup submit p50 for the country/provider over the last 30 days; null without samples. Raw attempts are never scanned.

**Auth:** None. Public endpoint.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `iso2` | path | string | yes |  | Constraints: minLength `2`, maxLength `2`. |

**Request body:** none.

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `200` | Routable routes. | `application/json`: array of object |
| `503` | A required dependency is unavailable. | `application/problem+json`: [Problem](schemas.md#problem) |

Response `200` fields (per array item):

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `provider` | string | yes |  |  |
| `carrier` | string \| null | no |  |  |
| `health` | string | yes |  |  |
| `cost` | string | yes |  |  |
| `currency` | string | yes |  |  |
| `priority` | integer | yes |  |  |
| `sell_price` | object \| null | yes |  |  |
| `sell_price.amount` | string | yes |  |  |
| `sell_price.currency` | string | yes |  |  |
| `p50_ms` | integer \| null | yes |  |  |
